settings.greeting:
Welcome to {business}! 👋
How can we help you today?
settings.guideText:
Here is our quick guide:

• Browse our catalogue and services at our website
• Orders are processed within 24 hours
• Delivery takes 2–5 working days

Need more help? Choose "Talk to our team" from the menu.
settings.orgPrompt: Great! Please tell us the *name of your organization* and we will connect you with the person who looks after your account.
settings.trackPrompt: Please send your *PO number*, *PR / REQ number* or *CN (tracking) number* (or the phone number used on the order).
settings.handoffMessage: Thank you! 🙌 You are now connected with *{agent}*{org}. They will reply to you shortly.
settings.noAgentMessage: Thank you! Our team has been notified and someone will reply to you very soon.
settings.trackOrgPrompt: To track your order, please first tell us the *name of your organization* (for example: BANK AL FALAH).
settings.trackOrgFirst: Please tell us your *organization name* first. After that, send your PO / P.R / CN number.
settings.trackOrgNotFound: We couldn't find an organization called *{q}*. Please type the organization name as it appears on your order, or type *4* to talk to our team.
settings.notFoundOrg: We couldn't find that organization in our records, so we've passed your chat to our team. Someone will reply shortly.
settings.notFoundOrder: We couldn't find an order matching *{q}*. Please check the ID and try again, or type *4* to talk to our team.
settings.retailPrompt:
Welcome, retail partner! 🏪
Please send your *shop account number*.

New shop? Type *NEW* and we will create an account number for you.
settings.closedMessage: This chat has been marked as resolved. Send any message to start again. 😊
